title: Interpret a menu document
description: Menu PDF → validated Menu Spec JSON (menu-interpreter sub-agent). Provide the uploaded PDF (preferred) or the raw menu text.

site_url.description: The site the spec belongs to (workspace destination).

pdf_file.description: Menu PDF — upload via POST /api/files first.

menu_text.description: Raw text of the menu document, if already extracted. Ignored when pdf_file is set.

source_filename.description: Original filename recorded as the spec's source. Defaults to the uploaded file's name.

title: Build the menu skeleton
description: Approved Menu Spec → Joomla categories, placeholder articles, and menu items (menu-builder sub-agent). Requires joomla_ids.menu_map in the spec.

spec.description: The full approved Menu Spec JSON with joomla_ids.menu_map populated.

spec_filename.description: Workspace filename to persist the updated spec to.

default_template_style_id.description: Gantry outline ID applied to every created menu item unless a spec item overrides it.

title: Derive the content schematic
description: Deterministically derive (or re-derive/merge) the Content Schematic from a Menu Spec — run after any spec edit and after the skeleton build. No LLM involved.

spec.description: The approved Menu Spec JSON to derive from.

schematic.description: Existing schematic to merge into, when re-deriving.

title: Interpret content from the source document
description: Fills the Content Schematic's content fields from the client PDF (content-interpreter sub-agent). Structure stays locked to the approved spec.

pdf_file.description: The client menu/content PDF — upload via POST /api/files first.

spec.description: The full approved Menu Spec JSON (post-Phase-3).

schematic.description: Existing schematic to merge into before interpreting.

source_filename.description: Recorded as the schematic's source. Defaults to the uploaded file's name.

title: Discover old-site source URLs
description: Proposes old-site URLs for schematic entries that need one, by scanning the old site's sitemap and fuzzy-matching titles. Proposals need human confirmation. No LLM involved.

site_url.description: The active (new) site — locates the workspace schematic.

base_url.description: The OLD site's base URL to scan (e.g. https://www.oldparishsite.org).

max_candidates.description: Max candidate URLs per entry. Default 3.

title: Fetch old-site page content
description: Fetches every eligible entry's old-site page, extracts the main content, and saves it as workspace markdown. No LLM involved.

refetch.description: Re-fetch entries that already have a source file. Default false.

title: Write and apply page content
description: Writes final Joomla article HTML for every writable entry (content-writer sub-agent, batched) and auto-applies it to the skeleton. Idempotent across re-runs.

node_keys.description: Explicit subset of node_keys to write.

apply.description: Auto-apply each batch to Joomla after writing. Default true.

force.description: Apply even over articles that already have real content. Default false.

dry_run.description: Report the plan without running the writer or touching Joomla.

title: Apply written content to Joomla
description: Pushes each written entry's HTML into its Joomla article. Refuses to overwrite real content unless force is set. No LLM involved.

force.description: Overwrite articles that already have real content. Default false.

dry_run.description: Report the plan without updating Joomla.

title: Agent transport ping (admin smoke test)
description: Sleeps 90 seconds emitting a progress heartbeat every 10s — validates the runtime → orchestrator → agents-mcp progress chain end-to-end.

site_url.description: Any site URL — agents-mcp tools are site-scoped.
